items.title: ActiveCloud (Belarus) cloud provider hit by ransomware
items.summary: Outage began Nov 10 and was confirmed as ransomware on Nov 11, encrypting part of its cloud and disrupting business websites, email and virtual servers in Belarus and Russia; many services restored by Nov 12, no evidence of customer data theft.

items.title: Leware Construction Company claimed by Storm-1567
items.summary: Leak-site listing with an attack date of Nov 11; the victim name comes from the listing only and is not yet confirmed by the company.

items.title: Everest posts 'final notice before publication' victim
items.summary: Everest leak-site entry dated Nov 13 with the victim only partly identified; treat as an unverified claim.

items.title: n0n group lists unnamed US company
items.summary: New n0n group listing with an attack date of Nov 9 against an unnamed US victim; signals another small group active this month.

items.title: Q3 2026 ransomware claims up 23%
items.summary: Leak-site tracking counted 2,865 ransomware victim claims in Q3 2026, a 23% rise.

ransomware.note: Thin named-victim reporting this cycle; three of five items are unverified leak-site claims.

items.title: Microsoft 365 disruption Nov 12-13
items.summary: A multi-hour Microsoft 365 incident logged under M365 incident IDs rather than Azure platform status, part of a cluster of major outages in mid-November.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2 (London) power loss
items.summary: Tracker reports an ~8-hour London-region outage attributed to a utility cable fault during single-feed maintenance when generators failed to start; dating is inconsistent across sources.

items.title: AWS among mid-November outage cluster
items.summary: AWS is listed among the major Nov 12-17 outages, with few technical details and no published post-event summary.

outage.note: Reporting is mostly secondary trackers; check provider status histories for authoritative detail.

items.title: CISA adds GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, IBM Aspera Faspex to KEV
items.summary: Four actively exploited flaws added Nov 9 with an unusually short Nov 12 federal remediation and forensic-triage deadline.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure flaws on KEV, Nov 13 deadline
items.summary: Two Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerabilities under active exploitation were added to KEV with a Nov 13 remediation deadline.

items.title: CISA warns of active exploitation of critical Node2Shell flaw
items.summary: CISA confirmed attackers are now exploiting the critical Node2Shell (Brotli) remote-code-execution flaw.

items.title: Zyxel GS1900 zero-day used to take over 996 switches
items.summary: Attackers used CVE-2026-107441 to hijack close to a thousand Zyxel GS1900 switches, per a Nov 4 brief.

items.title: Metabase, Windows and Cisco Secure Firewall flaws added to KEV
items.summary: KEV additions include a Metabase zero-day enabling unauthenticated admin access and data exfiltration.

items.title: M6.6 earthquake, 149 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia (Nov 16)
items.summary: Strong offshore quake in the Banda Sea region; USGS green alert, no tsunami.

items.title: M5.3 earthquake, Romania (Nov 18)
items.summary: Vrancea-zone quake 17 km ESE of Comandău, Romania.

items.title: M5.0 earthquake near Pinnacles, CA (Nov 20)
items.summary: Central California quake 10 km NW of Pinnacles; USGS green alert, feed tsunami flag set.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu landfall, Andhra Pradesh, India
items.summary: Made landfall Nov 3, the second cyclone to hit the Andhra Pradesh coast in under a week.

items.title: Brazil and Ecuador storm and flood emergencies
items.summary: Brazil recognized emergencies in 44 municipalities across 13 states; Ecuador flooding killed 12 and affected ~56,000 people.

physical.note: No confirmed Atlantic hurricane or major US wildfire activity found for November.
